name: robots/osudrl__cassie-mujoco-sim
title: Cassie MuJoCo simulation
intro: Cassie MuJoCo simulation, adapted from osudrl/cassie-mujoco-sim. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 3 more; runs `step` and `reset_simulation`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
